caption: Figure 5.6 Watson-Crick model for semiconservative DNA replication
note: Labels ordered as: the ten base-pair labels of the unreplicated parental duplex at the top (GC, AT, AT, GC, TA, CG, AT, GC, TA, CG, top to bottom); then the six unpaired bases down the left arm of the replication fork (A, T, G, T, A, C) and the six down the right arm (T, A, C, A, T, G); then the printed end marks 5' (left) and 3' (right); then the eight base-pair labels of the left daughter duplex (GC, TA, AT, CG, AT, GC, TA, GC) and the eight of the right daughter duplex (same sequence). Crop over-includes the right-hand column of body text (clipped single letters at the right edge), a sliver of a green section number, a clipped "gg" at the top, and the orange page-number block "88" at the bottom left; all excluded. Caption is printed on three lines and joined here.
